properties.name: reflow2 reports when a study's significance level, chosen test or hypothesis changed AFTER a data record was attached to it, so the criteria lock is checked, not only recorded
properties.statement:
For a study designed up front (hypothesis as a Requirement, α and acceptance criteria as Constraints, the test as a Decision), reflow2 compares each criterion's revision history with the time its data or result record was attached. Any change after that is reported by name, with both values and both times; this makes p-hacking and moved goalposts (HARKing) visible. Nothing is refused, because a change can be legitimate, but it is never silent.
Option (c) of flo2-calc's dec:idea-how-a-statistical-hypothesis-test-is-designed-computed-and-read. It checks what flo2-calc's accepted req:the-math-of-a-study-is-designed-up-front says the history shows.
